title: Keep the original building pose when several places select one building
classification: Source-backed accepted alias-mapping relocation defect; conditional valid multi-place input, no executed UI or shipped-data claim
contract_trace: SelectedBuildings::prepare maps every Place independently through select_building. Usage fallback can select the same actual building for two distinct place IDs; there is no injective mapping requirement or rejection. Street::arrange mutates that building once per place and unconditionally replaces moves[building_id] with a before/after pair. Interior furniture remains in its original world pose until after all moves, but relocate_interior_furniture interprets it using the last intermediate before pose rather than the original source pose.
counterexample: Two distinct valid Inn places with no people can both select the same first Inn building through usage fallback. Let original building pose be T0; first place moves it to T1; second moves it to T2; centering changes T2 to Tf. The map now holds (T1,Tf), so original furniture point p is relocated as Tf*inverse(T1)*p instead of Tf*inverse(T0)*p. For finite translation-only T0.x100, T1.x9, Tf.x9, furniture originally at100 stays100 although its final building centre is9. Exact coordinates illustrate the affine mechanism, not an executed fixture or assertion. Single-owner existing test remains coherent and does not cover aliased selection.
repair: For each canonical SceneBuildingId, retain the first original pose and update only the final pose on subsequent relocations/centering; apply one original-to-final conversion to its furniture. Prefer an owned relocation accumulator constructed from the original building cohort and finalized before mutating/publishing coupled building/furniture products. Reconcile with M77 street layout and M66/M70 accepted product contracts; do not introduce temporary primitive adapters, duplicate coordinate owners or reject previously valid place aliasing merely to hide the defect.
dependencies: SelectedBuildings::prepare/select_building fallback and Street::arrange whole shared function, canonical GeneratedBuilding placement/SceneBuildingId and FurnitureLocation::Interior relation.

relocate_interior_furniture must use the source pose in which its original positions/orientations were encoded; preserve original-to-final rotation delta, scale1 and checked Position/BuildingOrientation.
Outer strategic world preparation must discard Err candidate coherently; existing source fixtures only, no added tests.
acceptance: Any number of place IDs selecting the same building leaves its interior furniture at the same local building-relative poses after final placement/centering. Single-selection, frontage width/order, full-size building placement, checked coordinate errors and outdoor policies remain unchanged. All original-to-final associations use one canonical building owner.

M77 shared function ownership retained, no global uniqueness claim beyond compared records.
validation: Complete source bodies and affine reasoning only. No new tests/assertions/helpers, project checks, renderer or CI execution.
